narrative: Ordinary meadow battle ending before the boss

scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: individual vertical 9:16 cinematic keyframe for image-to-video, scene 01 of a six-scene continuous battle.
Input image: reference only, the attached PuffSlayers game screenshot. Preserve the exact recognizable cute chibi animal heroes, their colors, costumes, weapons, and hand-painted fantasy game aesthetic. Transform the gameplay view into a polished cinematic scene, NOT a UI screenshot.
Primary request: The small animal hero party encounters ordinary sunflower monsters and golden yellow flower-bud creatures on the same cracked ochre dirt path in a lush meadow. This is the opening of a regular enemy battle, before reaching any boss.
Subject: cream stout cat tank with blue cloth headgear and rectangular stone shield at front; small cream-and-orange sword cat with blue costume and tall shimmering blue-violet sword; white rabbit with pink inner ears, small gold accents, golden staff; little brown green-hooded woodland archer with branch-like bow. Match the four characters visibly on the battlefield in the reference, do not invent new heroes. Show friendly party in lower half, sunflower and yellow bud enemies ahead in upper middle.
Scene/backdrop: mossy broken stone walls, arching thorn vines, tiny white and pink meadow flowers, distant misty waterfalls and floating rocky cliffs, same soft magical afternoon light as the reference.
Composition: one full-frame portrait illustration, wide establishing view from slightly raised camera behind and beside the heroes, all characters readable with generous space for action. Camera facing along the path. Party looks toward enemies. No collage or panels.
Mood: playful fantasy combat about to begin, alert poses, gentle breeze and a few drifting petals, no attack explosion yet.
Constraints: strictly no boss, no giant enemy, no gore, no text, no numbers, no health bars, no menu buttons, no UI, no captions, no logo, no watermark. Keep consistent handcrafted painterly chibi game art, richly detailed environment, clear staging. Portrait 9:16.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE individual portrait 9:16 cinematic image-to-video keyframe, scene 02 of 06, an immediate continuation of reference image 2.
Input image 1 is the original game screenshot for canonical character identity and painterly game aesthetic. Input image 2 is scene 01 and is the strict continuity reference for all character designs, costumes, weapons, scale, environment and lighting. Preserve those four heroes and the three ordinary enemies, no extra characters.
Primary request: The two small sunflower monsters and one golden yellow flower-bud enemy rush down the cracked meadow path toward the hero party. Their leafy feet throw up small dust puffs and petals, with readable playful attack poses. The stout cream cat tank in blue headband steps forward and raises its rectangular stone shield to intercept the nearest sunflower. The sword cat in navy-and-gold outfit with glowing blue-violet sword waits just behind on the left. White rabbit mage with pink ears and gold sun staff prepares on the right; brown green-hooded woodland archer draws the branch bow behind them.
Composition: medium wide view, slightly lower and closer than scene 01, maintaining the party in foreground and enemies further up the same path. Characters occupy central 65 percent of frame, clear space around silhouettes, expressive readable faces in three-quarter profile. Freeze just BEFORE impact, not the same static pose as scene 01. No collage or panels.
Scene/backdrop: same flower meadow, broken mossy stone wall on left, curling thorn vines on both edges, floating cliffs and waterfall valley with distant castle high in background. Same warm afternoon lighting, same rich hand-painted chibi fantasy RPG art. Keep character identities exact, particularly the navy cat costume, blue headband tank, white-gold rabbit, green archer. Do not change medium to photorealism or 3D.
Constraints: ordinary combat only, NO BOSS or giant monster. No UI, text, health bars, damage numbers, logo, watermark, gore, dialogue bubbles. One clean full-frame vertical 9:16 scene for video.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: single full-frame portrait 9:16 keyframe for image-to-video, scene 03 of 06, the shield impact moment.
Input image 1 is original gameplay canonical character and aesthetic reference, image 2 is scene 01 costume/location continuity, image 3 is scene 02 immediately preceding this shot. These are references, not a collage to reproduce.
Primary request: Show the exact same stout cream-and-orange cat tank wearing the blue headband and navy-gold leather strapped gear bracing its large rectangular gray stone shield against one ordinary sunflower monster's leafy punch. A small bright gold impact spark and a semicircle of dust at the contact point, with flying yellow petals. The shield remains intact. The tank has a determined cute face and solid planted paws. This is one clear block action, no gore.
Composition: noticeably new camera angle, a dynamic medium close shot from the LEFT SIDE of the dirt path, seeing the tank's cream face in three-quarter profile. Tank at center-left and attacking sunflower at center-right, both near ground height. The cat sword hero in its identical navy robe with flower headpiece and blue-violet sword is clearly visible preparing to dash in the left background, white rabbit in white-gold outfit with sun staff and green-hooded brown archer appear smaller behind the tank; a second sunflower and golden yellow bud enemy are farther up the path. Only four heroes and the same three small ordinary enemies.
Environment: exactly same magical flower meadow, mossy wall, thorn vine arches, cracked ochre trail, floating cliff waterfall valley and distant castle; background softened moderately so the shield impact reads clearly. Same warm afternoon lighting and rich hand-painted fantasy chibi RPG illustration. Match all character designs, face proportions, outfits and weapons across shots.
Constraints: One individual image, portrait 9:16, no panels, no text, no numbers, no health bars, no UI, no logos, no watermark. NO BOSS, no giant creatures, no new characters, no gore, no photorealistic or plastic 3D rendering.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-frame portrait 9:16 cinematic battle keyframe for image-to-video, scene 04 of 06: sword counterattack.
Reference image 1 is scene 01 and locks the four heroes, their costumes, the meadow environment, style and afternoon lighting. Reference image 2 is scene 03 and locks the latest action continuity. Maintain these exact same characters without redesigning costumes.
Primary request: The small cream-and-orange sword cat in navy blue and gold tunic, flower-trimmed blue headpiece and blue cape dashes past its cat tank ally and swings its glowing blue-violet sword in ONE clean sweeping diagonal strike at the ordinary sunflower monster whose attack was just blocked. Show a crisp curved BLUE-VIOLET slash trail, not multiple swords, and a spray of yellow petals and dust. The sunflower recoils backward with a surprised cute expression, no injury, no blood. Tank with blue headband and rectangular stone shield stands close behind the sword hero, continuing to guard. The white rabbit with pink ears, white-gold robes and gold sun staff and brown green-hooded archer with leafy branch bow remain farther back preparing their next action. A second sunflower and yellow flower-bud enemy are farther up the path, still small regular enemies.
Composition: dynamic action shot from three-quarter side at character height. Sword cat is sharp focal subject in central foreground, face and single sword clearly visible and body readable; sunflower on right midground, tank on left midground, supports behind. Maintain travel toward upper right along the path, readable action axis. Single exposure, no cloned heroes, no multi-panel montage.
Environment: ochre cracked meadow path bordered with white and pink flowers, mossy ruined stone walls and dark thorn vines. Distant waterfalls, floating cliffs and castle visible softly at top. Same painterly detailed chibi fantasy game art and warm sunny light from previous scenes, NOT plastic 3D or realistic animals.
Constraints: only the same four animal heroes and three ordinary plant enemies. NO BOSS, no giant monster, no gore. No text, UI, bars, numbers, dialogue, captions, logos, or watermark. One portrait 9:16 image, no panel layout.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE individual full-frame portrait 9:16 image-to-video cinematic keyframe, scene 05 of 06: rabbit mage and woodland archer finish the ordinary enemy skirmish.
Input image 1 is scene 01, strict continuity reference for all four hero designs and environment. Input image 2 is scene 04, the moment immediately before this shot. Preserve exact outfits, face shapes, sizes and weapons. No new characters or redesign.
Primary request: The same small white rabbit with long pink inner ears in white-and-gold robes raises the golden sun-shaped staff and releases a graceful bright GOLD magical bolt toward the remaining yellow flower-bud enemy. Alongside the rabbit, the little brown green-hooded woodland archer releases ONE small luminous GREEN arrow from its leafy branch bow toward the second ordinary sunflower enemy. Show those two supports as the sharp foreground focal subjects, their expressive determined faces visible in three-quarter profile. Gold spell and green arrow trace separate clear trajectories across the middle of the image. The sunflower and flower-bud enemy recoil playfully in small showers of petals and sparkles, no gore. The first sunflower defeated by the sword in scene 04 is a small fading petal sparkle cloud at the edge of path, no body.
The cream-and-orange sword cat in navy-gold outfit with blue headpiece and blue-violet sword, and stout cream cat tank with blue headband and rectangular stone shield, remain visible to the side in midground guarding the supports; both look toward the enemies, exact consistent designs.
Composition: camera shifted toward RIGHT SIDE of the path, medium wide action shot at animal-eye height, rabbit near foreground right, green archer near foreground left, enemies higher along the dirt path. Dynamic but very readable distinct silhouettes, avoid covering faces with effects. Single moment, one clear gold bolt and one green arrow only. Give effects breathing room within frame.
Environment: identical cracked ochre meadow trail, banks of white and pink flowers, mossy wall, looping thorn vines; the distant floating cliff waterfalls and castle remain softly visible at top. Same golden afternoon light and richly detailed painterly chibi fantasy RPG aesthetic. No 3D plastic or realistic animal look.
Constraints: NO BOSS, no giant enemy, no new hero, no UI, no labels, text, health bars, damage numbers, captions, logo or watermark. Non-gory cute combat. No collage or multiple panels. One vertical 9:16 cinematic illustration.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE clean individual full-frame portrait 9:16 cinematic image-to-video keyframe, scene 06 of 06, ending the normal meadow skirmish BEFORE reaching any boss.
Input image 1 is scene 01 and is the strict character design, costume, environment, style and lighting reference. Input image 2 is scene 05 and is the immediately preceding action continuity reference.
Primary request: The same four cute animal heroes have won the short battle against ordinary flower monsters and start walking onward along the meadow dirt trail. All plant enemies are gone; just a few fading gold and green sparkles and drifting yellow petals remain at the trail edges. No enemies, no treasure, no new objects or characters. A relaxed satisfied mood after combat. The cream stout cat tank with blue headband carries its intact rectangular gray stone shield lowered to its side, the cream-and-orange sword cat in navy-gold costume and floral blue headpiece carries its single blue-violet sword pointing safely downward, white rabbit with pink ears in white-gold robe carries the gold sun staff upright but no longer casting, and little brown woodland archer in green leafy hood lowers its branch bow. Preserve exact same silhouettes, outfits and weapons as the references.
Composition: return to a wider slightly elevated rear three-quarter shot echoing scene 01. All four heroes walk away from camera in the middle-lower half of the frame, entire bodies visible, loosely side-by-side with tank leading by a step. Their small faces can be seen in slight side profile, relieved cute expressions. The EMPTY cracked dirt path continues winding uphill between flowers in upper middle. This is a calm outro, with open space ahead and no battle effects covering the party.
Scene: exact same meadow and time of day, ruined moss-covered stone walls, looping dark thorn vines, white and pink flowers, distant waterfall valley, floating cliffs, and the same faraway castle high in background. The heroes remain in the meadow far from the castle. Do not bring them to a castle gate, boss arena, portal or new location. Soft warm late afternoon sun, breeze lifting the blue capes and a few petals. Beautiful polished detailed HAND-PAINTED CHIBI fantasy game art, consistent with all earlier shots.
Constraints: Absolutely NO BOSS, boss shadow, silhouette, giant monster or new threat. No combat enemies left. No UI, text, captions, numbers, bars, menu buttons, logos or watermark. No panels or collage. Single portrait 9:16 illustration.
